title: ACP dated versions and post-release edits
caption: Five dated spec folders, no Git tags or GitHub releases. Two released folders were edited after their release date, so pin a commit as well as a version.
alt: Flowchart of versions in order: 2025-09-29 initial checkout and Delegate Payment with five statuses; 2025-12-12 fulfillment_details, selected_fulfillment_options, authentication_required and affiliate attribution; 2026-01-16 authentication provider and adyen; 2026-01-30 capabilities, payment handlers, extensions, eleven statuses and line_items without quantity; 2026-04-17 cart, Feed API, Delegate Authentication, acp.json discovery, MCP binding and required Idempotency-Key; then unreleased work with 18 commits to 2026-07-18. Notes show 2026-01-30 edited from 2026-02-05 to 2026-02-13 and 2026-04-17 edited on 2026-05-01 and 2026-06-15.
